keyDrivers: High canal/tubewell irrigation buffer (98%); low monsoon dependence; stable MSP procurement infrastructure

keyDrivers: High mechanisation, reliable canal networks, established APMC procurement
mitigationAdvice: Sow heat-tolerant varieties (HD 3086, DBW 187) by early November to hedge against terminal heat stress in March.

keyDrivers: High historical Pink Bollworm and Whitefly pressure; saline groundwater in southern blocks; price volatility in global cotton markets
mitigationAdvice: Use certified non-Bt refuge borders, install pheromone traps at 5/acre, and avoid unauthorized F2 hybrid seeds.

keyDrivers: High monsoon dry spell frequency (Marathwada rain shadow); shallow black soil moisture stress; pest resurgence
mitigationAdvice: Implement broad bed and furrow (BBF) in situ moisture conservation; maintain farm pond (Shet-tale) for critical protective irrigation.

keyDrivers: High waterlogging susceptibility during July peak monsoon; international edible oil price cycles
mitigationAdvice: Adopt ridge-and-furrow planting system to prevent waterlogging; treat seed with Trichoderma viride + Carboxin.

keyDrivers: Fall Armyworm (FAW) incidence during early vegetative stage; moderate post-monsoon dry spells
mitigationAdvice: Seed treatment with Cyantraniliprole 19.8% + Thiamethoxam 19.8% FS; whorl application of neem cake / sand mixture.

keyDrivers: Indira Gandhi Canal command coverage; frost/cold wave vulnerability in late December
mitigationAdvice: Give light protective irrigation or spray 0.1% dilute sulphuric acid on expected frost nights.

keyDrivers: Cauvery Mettur dam release timing variance; North-East monsoon cyclonic excess rainfall
mitigationAdvice: Opt for flood/submergence tolerant varieties like Swarna-Sub1; ensure field drainage channels are desilted.

keyDrivers: High fertile alluvial soils; Damodar Valley canal network; localized waterlogging during cyclonic depressions
mitigationAdvice: Practice Alternate Wetting and Drying (AWD) water management; monitor for Brown Plant Hopper.

keyDrivers: Hirakud canal command security; Rice Bowl of Odisha; pest outbreak history in continuous monocropping
mitigationAdvice: Crop rotation with pulses (Green gram/Black gram) in Rabi season to break pest cycles and enhance soil nitrogen.
